name: file_write
description: Write content to a file. Creates parent directories if needed.

manual.overview: Use file_write to create new files or overwrite existing ones. It can also append to files like logs. Parent directories are created automatically.
tips: Use append mode for log files to avoid losing previous entries.
Always double-check the path before writing to avoid overwriting important files.
For editing existing files, prefer file_edit over file_write to make surgical changes.
edge_cases: Writing to a read-only file will fail with a permission error.
Without append mode, the entire file is replaced — not just updated.
